about: 2011 Census BCP B01/B07/B08A/B08B/B09/B14/B24/B25/B26/B28/B32/B40B/B45B/B46 SA1 tables (the Basic Community Profile, the GCP's pre-2016 form), pooled to New South Wales's 93 state electoral districts for the 28 March 2015 election (the 2013 redistribution's boundaries — nsw15 and nsw19 share the district set, the census edition differs). Each SA1 counts whole to the district its polygon centroid lies in (boundary SA1s are not split; the state total is never moved; the SA1→district assignment is the join cache .build/map/nsw13/assign-sa1-2011.json, the same one the SEIFA lanes pool over). Bases match the federal stores (ex-not-stated): language other than English over English-only+other stated; age shares renormalised over B01's 11 bands (which exclude age-not-stated); overseas-born over country-stated, and the birthplace-country shares (cob, order in cobKeys) riding the same country-stated basis — the BCP's B09 table merges the UK's countries, so the lane carries the eight-country readable set (England and Scotland are not separately readable in 2011); university (bachelor and above) over the B01 aged-15+ population less level-of-education-not-stated; blue-collar (trades, machinery operators and drivers, labourers) over the eight stated ANZSCO groups; the new lane set mirrors the federal stores (year-12-or-less over B01's six printed stated schooling levels; B07 Tot-row Indigenous/ Indigenous-plus-non-Indigenous; B14's Religion menu ten shares (rel, key order in relKeys) over the ex-affiliation-not-stated persons basis; B32's Housing-tenure menu four shares (ten, key order in tenKeys) over the ex-tenure-not-stated occupied-private-dwellings basis; B25's one-parent lane (persons in one-parent families over persons in families — the BCP prints it on a persons basis); the under-15 share of the stated ages). Income lanes are the 2011 edition's 14-band grid in 2011 dollars, the state-universe quantile cuts New South Wales's own. p is census persons; n the SA1 count. The four NSW sentinel SA1s (migratory/offshore) carry no polygon and sit outside the join, holding 13030 persons statewide.
